mapper.select: SELECT id, name, des, CAST(price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS price, CAST(stock AS UNSIGNED) AS stock, CAST(sales AS UNSIGNED) AS sales, images, category_by AS categoryBy, create_date AS createDate, update_date AS updateDate, del_flay AS delFlay FROM t_yaopenghao_products WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flay = '0'
